name: Flatline
source:
You stumble upon a computer which is running a peculiar program. A wave stretches across the screen, and it is up to you to find out what it means, by questioning the less than helpful AI inhabiting the computer.

[From http://www.drakkashi.com/portfolio/flatline.php]
translation:
你偶然发现一台运行着奇怪程序的电脑。屏幕上横贯着一道波形，你需要询问电脑里那个不怎么帮得上忙的人工智能，弄清它的含义。

[摘自http://www.drakkashi.com/portfolio/flatline.php]
